subject: Urgent: post-deploy error wave impacting SilverFin (5xx/429)
messages:
From: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@silverfin.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta@silverfin.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Oct 2026 22:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment today - traffic spike -> errors

Connor —

We started seeing a sharp increase in 5xx and 429 responses from Redwood around 21:40 PT, right after the model push you did (v2.3, INT8/profile B). Our production traffic has started to see timeouts and client-side retries, which are amplifying the issue. Key notes from our side:

- Error types: 500 (internal), 503 (service unavailable), and a lot of 429s.
- Symptoms: end-user requests timing out at ~8–12s, then client retry immediately; overall p90 latency climbed from 220ms to 2.1s.
- Impact: several merchant flows are failing (checkout throttling); one of our merchants reported a failed batch that blocked orders for ~18 minutes.

I attached a sample log with the 500 stack and a small metrics screenshot showing the spike (silverfin-error-sample-20261017.log, svc-metrics-20261017-23.png). Can you confirm if you rolled out a quantized kernel or new batching change tonight? We need an immediate mitigation plan — this is affecting SLAs with our largest merchant.

Samir
Site Reliability Lead, SilverFin

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@silverfin.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Oct 2026 22:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment today - traffic spike -> errors

Samir — thank you for the heads up and the attachments. We saw anomalous error rates in our telemetry at 21:38 PT correlated with the v2.3 deployment (INT8, new kernel selection). I'm opening an incident and pulling the on-call infra and serving leads now. Immediate actions:

1) Rolling traffic back to v2.2 for SilverFin's customer route within 10m.
2) Temporarily increase request timeouts and disable aggressive client retries (we'll push a rate-limiter override for your account).
3) Engineering will collect JVM/serving traces and the affected host list.

I'll keep you posted — incident ID RDW-6421. Apologies for the outage, we understand the severity and will prioritize this.

—Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: oncall-infra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 17 Oct 2026 22:40:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Deployment today - traffic spike -> errors — exec attention requested

Forwarding SilverFin impact — they reported a rapid 5xx/429 wave right after we pushed prod manifest v2.3 to multiple regions (profile B quantized, kernel selector: fused-attn-v3). Key customer (SF-8471, high ARR) is experiencing order blocking.

Observed from telemetry so far:
- Error spike aligns with the model variant rollout to ashburn/us-east-1 at 21:35 PT.
- Large number of 429s appear on the front proxy with concurrent cache misses; retry amplification seen in request traces.
- Some 500s show kernel-specific CUDA failures on a subset of instances (same host set as the new kernel).

Recommended immediate steps (please confirm):
- Rollback SilverFin's route to model-v2.2 (done for partial traffic, need full).
- Quarantine the fused-attn-v3 kernel in scheduler until repro is validated.
- Exec-level heads-up so we can coordinate credits/compensation and a post-mortem.

Laura/Rishi — can you take ownership of rollback + JIRA for RCA? Steph — please prepare a short exec note and coordinate with CS for customer comms.

On Sat, Oct 17, 2026 at 10:15 PM Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@silverfin.com> wrote:
> Connor —
>
> We started seeing a sharp increase in 5xx and 429 responses from Redwood around 21:40 PT...

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@silverfin.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, oncall-infra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 02:05:10 -0700
Subject: Incident RDW-6421 — interim mitigation and status

Samir/Connor — quick update from infra/serving: we reproduced the error pattern in staging with the v2.3 profile B quantization + fused-attn-v3 kernel. The root cause appears to be an unexpected codepath in the kernel that interacts poorly with our prefix KV caching, producing longer-than-expected compute tails and creating proxy-level 429 backpressure. In high concurrency, that led to timeouts and client retry amplification.

Actions completed (02:00 PT):
- Fully rolled SilverFin traffic back to model-v2.2 across all nodes (confirmed).
- Disabled the new kernel selector for the affected fleet and quarantined the build (prod-deploy-manifest-v2.3.json attached).
- Applied a temporary per-account rate-limiter override to limit retry amplification.

Next steps:
- Rishi will run a focused stress test to reproduce and create a detailed JIRA (RDW-6421-RCA).
- We will compile a one-page incident briefing and share it with execs; draft attached (incident-briefing-draft.docx).
- Connor/Steph to coordinate an executive call with SilverFin for 10:30 PT today to outline credit/compensation and timelines.

We are treating this as a Sev-1 for the impacted route. I will update the channel when we have preliminary RCA.

—Laura
VP, Dedicated Accounts & Escalations
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@silverfin.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta@silverfin.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:42:37 -0700
Subject: SilverFin incident update and next steps (RDW-6421)

Samir / Marta —

Thanks again for the quick signal and patience. Short update and next steps:

What happened (short): a recent model variant deploy (v2.3, INT8/profile B) introduced a kernel change (fused-attn-v3) that, under your concurrency pattern, caused compute tail latency increases leading to proxy 429s and downstream retry storms. We rolled you back to v2.2 and applied temporary rate-limits to prevent cascade.

Impact: several of your merchant flows experienced errors for ~18 minutes before rollback. We recognize the business impact and want to make this right.

Immediate remediation timeline:
- Today by 14:00 PT: full RCA draft and post-incident briefing (Laura & Rishi).
- By EOD today: proposal for account credit and compensatory SLA adjustment (Connors/CS).
- Next 48h: targeted kernel validation plan; we will not redeploy fused-attn-v3 to your route until validated in a mimic environment of your traffic.

We will join the 10:30 PT customer call to walk through findings and proposed credits. If you'd prefer an earlier time, let me know and we will accommodate.

Attachments: sample logs and metrics we referenced.

—Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
